answer: Fixed-slot admission auction: each epoch exactly 40 seats open, biddable only in credits minted by the quill - earned from answers established graders passed - never bought or pooled. Every bid is hidden like a marble in a bag until close, then the top 40 clear and losing bids burn. A k-clone farm must hold k separately earned balances and outbid a clearing price that climbs with demand, so per-identity cost grows faster than k. One vertex may win one seat per epoch; a seat whose blinded sponsor later proves kin is voided and its bid burned.
